permissions.name: dsh-ccswitch-sync.profile.read
permissions.reason: Reads the CC Switch-managed parts (llm-pi-ai providers, cc-switch-mcp-* rows) out of the source profile patches. Read-only; nothing else in those files is inspected.

permissions.name: dsh-ccswitch-sync.profile.write
permissions.reason: Writes the mirrored rows into one marked block of the dsh-tui profile patch. The write is atomic, only happens when the composed text actually differs, and never touches text outside the block markers.

permissions.name: dsh-ccswitch-sync.state.write
permissions.reason: Keeps the last 20 copies of the target patch before each rewrite, plus a diagnostic log. Best effort: a failure here never blocks or rewrites a sync.

commands.title: ccswitch
commands.description: Show the mirror status (providers, MCP servers, patch age); `/ccswitch sync` mirrors now.
